recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a narrow, directly traceable application defect in the FHIR-20582 Request comment while preserving the later FHIR-28543 Event decision. Product.encounter and the resource-specific MedicationRequest.encounter short override still contain separate old wording and should be handled only by separate human-reviewed tracker work if a work group wants that wording changed.
issue_request: FHIR-20582 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked the Request and Event pattern encounter short descriptions to stop saying "Encounter created as part of" because that sounded as if the Encounter was created by the request or event, and it also asked to rewrite the Request encounter comment to say "encounter during which the request was created".
initial_application: Jira records Git 193d552d63 as the application commit. That commit applied the Request.encounter short wording and rewrote the Request encounter comment, but the rewritten templated plural was malformed as "{{title}s". Later checked-in request mapping exception files added in Git 086649a235 inherited the malformed pattern-side comment.
additional_context: A later Published Event-specific issue, FHIR-28543, changed Event.encounter to "Encounter the {{title}} is part of" because "tied to" was considered too loose; that later decision is already represented on the combined branch and explains why Event was not changed back to the FHIR-20582 wording. The Request logical pattern and all edited request-derived resource folders are active in source/fhir.ini. No Zulip or Confluence record for FHIR-20582 was found that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml from "{{title}s" to "{{title}}s" and updated the nine active request mapping exception pattern comments to use concrete resource plurals instead of the malformed placeholder.
source_changes: source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml: corrected the Request.encounter comment placeholder from "{{title}s" to "{{title}}s".

source/{careplan,communicationrequest,devicerequest,medicationrequest,nutritionorder,requestorchestration,servicerequest,task,visionprescription}/*-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: replaced the malformed pattern-side Request.encounter placeholder with concrete resource plurals.
